author: pcteddy
body:
Boldandbrash gave me permission to create one more app due to my last one having a lack of detail.

Age: 14

Timezone: Gmt

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes - Pcteddy -

Do you have Discord? Yes - Pcteddy -

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes. Bandicam and OBS. OBS is my main and Bandicam is a backup




CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION



Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? No I do not. 


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? 

 

My biggest weakness is being able to pick out hackers. This will affect my moderating for the first few weeks but I think as time goes on I will become better. As i can record i can ask other mods for there opinion but sometimes they are blatant so they can be easily spotted.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

 

I think that the qualities a leader should have are:

 

Focus,

Confidence,

Determination,

Inspiration,

Passion,

Patience,

authenticity,

open mindedness,

positivity,

generosity,

Teamwork,

 

I would class myself as a leader because I think I have most of these qualities. Also I think there could be some I could work on and I think working as a team would help me build up those skills.  

 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

 

I can be quite stubborn sometimes towards things and I think being stubborn is a quilty you should have when being a moderator becuase you can uphold the rules to there your potential. Also I like enfocring the rules to make players follow them as it can be annoying when they don't


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

 

I think the skills you should have when interacting with the community are:

 

Communication, 

Listen to what people have to say,

Be positvie towards the other players,

Be able to answer people’s questions to the best of your knowledge,

Treat everyone the same,

Don’t be rude to people even if you don’t like them,


I believe that I have these skills and can show that I can use them to their full potential. I like to be posotive to everyone because why would people want to play with someone who is negative all the time. Also I like to treat everyone the same because I belive  that makes people feal welcome to the server. 

 

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

 

be stubborn, 

be paitient,

be friendly,

 

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS



You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

 

I would ask the staff member not to do what he is doing. I would then, if he keeps doing it, contact an senior or administrator to deal with the staff member of course providing evidence for the false bans. 

You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

 

I would ask them not to talk about the staff member but because it is allowed there is not much else I could do. Also I would encourage them not to do it because speeking about people in a negative way becuase I find isn't nice. Even if you don' like someone you shouldn't speak about it you should keep it to yourself. 


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

 

I wouldn’t do anything apart from ask him to keep it private from staff who may be on other teams because it is up to the staff member who he wants to see it. Even though the rest of the team and other players might not like it it is up to him.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

 

I would immediately ban the senior staff members from teamspeak and inform an administrator or a developer. I would contact senior staffs who are not banned to give the players there ranks back. I would also tell the players that the staff members in question will be dealt with accordingly. Also I would remove the channles they created and the messages they sent.

 


CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


Why do you want to be a moderator? 

 

I want to be a moderator because i have always wanted to be a moderator and have failed at applications. That was becuase i was underage but they didn't post the age limit. But also I have always wanted to expiriance the server from a different view becuase after a while it gets boering being a player for almost 4 years with a defult rank.


What does Avicus mean to you?

 

 It means quite alot becuase i have been playing on the server for almost 4 years and it's always been a nice place to play games on. Also me and my friends have always had a game on and we allways enjoy it becuase the community is always very nice and freindly.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? No. The staff team are perfect in everyway possible. 


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

 

Cause i have been playing for almost 4 years and it's boering always being defult becuase there is almost no action. I also like the server because it is so friendly and so nice. Also the staff make me feel welcome and I would like to carry on with making people feel welcome.

 

Do you have anything else to add to your application? 


This is my second App becuase my first one was denied for lack of detail. Boldandbrash gave me permission to create one more.
